item.title: About
item.description:
I break things on my own server so nothing breaks on a production one.

Trained software engineer at 42 Lisboa (C, C++, Linux, networking), building my cloud/infrastructure career the hands-on way: I run a Linux-first home lab on repurposed hardware — a multi-service Docker stack (media, file sync, document pipeline) that I administer over SSH via Tailscale, manage with Portainer, and back up with rsync. Currently extending it with Terraform and Kubernetes, and evaluating AWS vs Azure as its first cloud target.
